The e d ending and
ing ending are small endings to words,
but they make a big difference. So, it's
important that you understand when to
use these
endings. Ed D shows a past action.
We use ed d to talk about something that
already happened. These are regular
verbs. Here are some examples using the
ending ed d. I am going to read these
examples in slow English and then I will
read it in normal
speed. I cleaned my room. I cleaned my
room. She called her friend. She called
her friend. We watched a movie. We
watched a movie. He opened the window.
He opened the window. They played
soccer. They played soccer. All of these
actions are finished. The
ing ending shows an action that is
happening now. We use it with verbs like
am,
is,
